mission_09: Fantastic! You have built a complete federated learning framework from scratch. Your implementation captures the essential server-client architecture used by production frameworks like Flower, FedML, and PySyft. The orchestration layer handles model distribution, client training coordination, weighted aggregation, and metric tracking. This framework can be extended with the privacy and efficiency techniques you learned in previous missions: add differential privacy to client_train, secure aggregation to server_orchestrate, and communication compression to the model transfer. Understanding this architecture gives you the foundation to contribute to or build upon existing FL frameworks, and to design custom solutions for specific deployment scenarios.
